Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.41 fixes the softlock where nighttime, closing, and morning CG window dialogues (such as Lydia's harem night invitation) stopped advancing after the first line and locked sleeping; reveals the closed shutter during no-client window dialogues so scene portraits and expressions remain visible at the counter; blocks leaving the store or reopening the bedroll during window dialogues/CGs; and cleans up portraits and monologue state on abort or leaving the store so sprites cannot leak into after-hours scenes. All 1.40/1.39/1.38 content and compatibility fixes remain. 1.41 修复夜间、闭店与晨间 CG 窗口对白（如后宫线莉迪亚睡前邀请）在弹出第一句后无法继续推进、导致睡眠按钮卡死的问题；无客人窗口对白期间自动移开关闭的卷帘门遮罩以正常显示窗前立绘与 1.40 表情变化；对白与全屏 CG 期间锁定侧门、睡袋与夜游地图，并在异常中断或离店时自动清理立绘与对白状态，避免立绘残留到博士等外出场景。保留 1.40/1.39/1.38 全部内容与兼容修复。简体中文 / English / 日语 / 韩语 (ZH / EN / JA / KO)。
